answer: According to Johnson et al. (2022), deployment bias arises when algorithmic outputs are used in a manner inconsistent with the algorithms used to produce them, such as through rounding or truncation. It is important to address deployment bias to ensure fairness in automated scoring for writing and speaking assessments, as it can lead to unjust outcomes and misinterpretations of the model's results. Addressing this bias is critical for maintaining the integrity and trustworthiness of AI systems in educational contexts.
